scope: Related controlled 1/3/10-minute repeats; actual production Worker, CPU auto_v1 with explicit 2/4 threads. References remain host-only. Full tokens/vectors are not collected or replayed in this performance run. Stage PSS and periodic RSS/PSS/thermal samples are snapshots, not continuous peaks. Device caches/temperature, instrumentation and sampling overhead are uncontrolled; no causal speed, ARM, natural-dialogue or independent-quality acceptance is established.

protocol.selection_scope: Performance protocol fixed before these derived inputs receive any new inference; not quality tuning or new independent acceptance.
protocol.threads_request: explicit 2/4; no core-count auto request; oversubscription on a 2-core emulator is possible
protocol.restarts: No intentional app restart within each three-case instrumentation batch; separate instrumentation invocations between batches.
protocol.sampling: Stage boundary PSS plus periodic RSS/PSS/thermal snapshots; not continuous peak memory. Sampler/instrumentation overhead and device conditions uncontrolled.
protocol.quality: Raw/normalized/cpWER and utterance-proxy DER reported separately for related repeats. No new gate, no pooling with dev/holdout/reserve, no natural-dialogue/ARM/speed causal claim.

protocol.rate_units: fraction; null for an undefined denominator
protocol.raw_wer: whitespace tokens; exact case, attached punctuation, ё and numeric spelling; rows ordered by start_ms/end_ms
protocol.normalized: NFC lowercase, ё→е, non-letter/non-number characters become spaces; CER removes spaces
protocol.punctuation: micro F1 for . , ? ! — : anchored to preceding equal lexical token after normalized alignment; BEGIN anchor before first token; substitutions/insertions do not match anchors
protocol.initial_case: first cased letter of each reference segment, aligned by normalized lexical word; unmatched initials count incorrect; conditional_accuracy excludes unmatched
protocol.der: full recording [0,duration_ms], overlap included, optimal global speaker permutation reoptimized after collar exclusion; collar total width ±half around each reference boundary
protocol.cpwer: minimum sum of Levenshtein costs over speaker-concatenated streams, padded empty streams for unequal counts; raw and normalized
protocol.timing: global one-to-one maximum-total temporal IoU matching of positive-duration segments; only positive-IoU pairs; text/speaker independent; granularity-dependent

wer_number_normalized.scope: cardinal integers after lexical normalization; dates/times/percent/ordinals are not semantically interpreted

telemetry.memoryScope: stage boundary PSS snapshots; not continuous peak memory
